facts: Parties: Brightwater Logistics plc (Buyer), Fenwick Holdings Ltd (Seller); the Company is Oakhurst Medical Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 2 January 2026; Closing is scheduled for 25 March 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 2 January 2026), either party may terminate.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Yarrow Energy plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Lowther Engineering Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 16 June 2026.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Oakhurst Technologies Ltd.
